crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The sample is the legitimate Windows command-line FTP client utility (ftp.exe). Its functionality, including extensive networking imports (socket, connect, send, recv, TransmitFile), string artifacts ("FTP.exe LUA manifest", "RETR", "STOR", "PORT"), and function names (get, put, mget, mput, ls, shell), is entirely consistent with an FTP client. The binary allows users to connect to FTP servers to upload and download files. The 'shell' function, which executes local commands via `CreateProcessW` with `cmd.exe /c`, is a standard feature for interactive command-line tools and does not indicate malicious intent in this context.
